definitions.gloss: name tag, name plate, name badge
definitions.explanation: A tag or badge displaying a person's name, worn on clothing or placed on a desk or door. Used in schools, workplaces, conferences, and hospitals.

examples.japanese: {名札|なふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To put on a name tag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名札|なふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: The conference participants wore name tags on their chests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名札|なふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{学年|がくねん}→学年：00056_gakunen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Elementary school students write their name and grade on their name tag.

notes:
{名札|なふだ} is a tag or badge displaying a person's name. Compound of ⟦{名|な}→名：03496_na⟧ (name) + ⟦{札|ふだ}→札：23002_fuda⟧ (tag, card).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名札|なふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧/⟦{着|つ}ける→着く：00680_tsuku⟧: to put on a name tag
- {名札|なふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}す→外す：02394_hazusu⟧: to take off a name tag
- {名札|なふだ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write one's name on a tag

USAGE:
Common in Japanese schools (especially elementary), hospitals, conferences, and workplaces. Japanese ⟦{小学生|しょうがくせい}→小学生：03069_shougakusei⟧ typically wear {名札|なふだ} on their clothes or bags with their name and class.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名札|なふだ}: name tag (worn on person or placed on desk)
- ⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧: business card (exchanged at meetings)
- ⟦{表札|ひょうさつ}→表札：04886_hyousatsu⟧: nameplate (on a house or building entrance)
- ネームプレート: name plate (loanword, often used in offices)
